abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the safety and efficacy of laparoscopic management of ovarian dermoid cysts based upon our ten years' experience. METHODS: Charts of 81 patients who underwent laparoscopic removal of dermoid cysts since March 1988 at Stanford University Medical Center or the Center for Special Pelvic Surgery in Atlanta were reviewed retrospectively. RESULTS: Ninety-three dermoid cysts with a mean diameter of 4.5 cm were removed in 81 patients. Operative techniques used were cystectomy for 70 cysts, salpingooophorectomy for 14, and 9 salpingo-oophorectomy with hysterectomy. Fifty-three cysts were treated via enucleation followed by cystectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy and removal through a trocar sleeve. Twenty-two were treated via enucleation and removal within an impermeable sack. Nine were treated via enucleation and removal by posterior colpotomy. Nine were removed via colpotomy following hysterectomy. We had a total of 39 spillages. Spillage rates varied with removal method: 32 (62%) for trocar removal without an endobag, 3 (13.6%) for removal within an endobag, and 4 (40%) with colpotomy removal. No spillage occurred for the nine patients who had a colpotomy done for hysterectomy. Mean hospital stay after surgery was 0.98 days, and there were no intraoperative complications. In one case, there was a postoperative complication of an incisional infection in the umbilicus. CONCLUSION: Including this and 13 other studies, review of the literature reveals a 0.2% incidence of chemical peritonitis following laparoscopic removal of dermoid cysts. Thus, we conclude that laparoscopic management of dermoid cysts is a safe and beneficial method in selected patients when performed by an experienced laparoscopic surgeon.
abstract_ja: 目的：10年間の経験に基づき、卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡下治療の安全性と有効性を明らかにすること。方法：1988年3月以降、スタンフォード大学医療センターまたはアトランタのCenter for Special Pelvic Surgeryで腹腔鏡下に類皮嚢腫摘出術を受けた81例のカルテを後方視的に検討した。結果：81例から平均直径4.5cmの類皮嚢腫93個が摘出された。術式は嚢腫摘出術70個、卵管卵巣摘出術14個、卵管卵巣摘出術と子宮摘出術の併施9個であった。53個は被膜剥離後に嚢腫摘出または卵管卵巣摘出を行い、トロッカースリーブを通して摘出した。22個は被膜剥離後、非透過性の袋内で摘出した。9個は被膜剥離後、後膣円蓋切開から摘出した。9個は子宮摘出後に膣断端切開から摘出した。内容物の漏出は計39件であった。漏出率は摘出方法により異なり、エンドバッグを使わないトロッカー摘出で32件（62%）、エンドバッグ内摘出で3件（13.6%）、膣切開による摘出で4件（40%）であった。子宮摘出に伴い膣切開を行った9例では漏出はなかった。平均在院日数は0.98日で、術中合併症はなかった。術後合併症として臍部の創感染が1例にみられた。結論：本研究と他の13件の研究を含めた文献的検討では、腹腔鏡下類皮嚢腫摘出後の化学性腹膜炎の発生率は0.2%であった。したがって、適切に選択された症例において、経験豊富な腹腔鏡手術医が行えば、腹腔鏡下類皮嚢腫摘出は安全で有益な方法である。
